scientific_integrity: Underlying Gaussian/Bessel transform and classical asymptotics explicitly credited. Independent publication priority and outside mathematical validation are unverified.
scientific_limitations: Real planar Fourier zeros and the two-component Gaussian/normalized-circle mixture only; radial multiplicity not geometric intersection. Asymptotic error constants may depend on fixed Gaussian parameter. The pairwise crossover theorem does not rule out triple coincidences. Numerical checks corroborate but do not replace analytical proof. Originality remains limited by indexing and access; no independent audit.
title: Exact Fourier nodal-ring folds and pairwise threshold reversals for a Gaussian–circle mixture
